text: At 65 minutes, Seabrook Town changes their tactics to press higher up the field and play more directly. Their defensive line moves up closer to Harbour City's goal, increasing pressure along the middle and wide flanks. This shift aims to quickly advance the ball into attacking areas on the left and right wings, creating opportunities for crosses into the penalty area. Harbour City, positioned deeper near their own goal, stays composed with patient passing, limiting Seabrook's impact despite their intensified efforts [#1361].
